notes: The quoted passage is only the closing formula of the Dānadharma section of the Anuśāsanaparvan (adhyāya 167, śloka count 7800). It names no persons and gives no date. The catalogue gives the scribe as Vālakṛṣṇa Aryāla and the date as ŚS 1779 / VS 1914. These two eras agree: ŚS 1779 + 78 = 1857 and VS 1914 − 57 = 1857, so about 1857 CE. Neither detail is in the quoted text, so neither is recorded here. They probably come from another colophon in the manuscript that the cataloguer did not quote.
